paper_title: MMAR A Challenging Benchmark for Deep Reasoning in Speech, Audio,   Music, and Their Mix
caption: Different Audio-Language models’ performance on MMAU (test-mini) and MMAR.

annotations.annotation: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy percentages for different categories related to two groups, MMAU and MMAR. The horizontal axis contains the categories labeled as Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, Audio-Reasoner, and Qwen-2.5-Omni in that order. The vertical axis represents the value axis, labeled "Accuracy (%)", and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 70, with tick labels at intervals of 10 units. Each category contains two bars: the first bar, representing MMAU, is blue, while the second bar, representing MMAR, is purple. In the Qwen2-Audio-Instruct category, the MMAU bar is approximately 50% in height, and the MMAR bar is about 30%. For the Audio-Reasoner category, the MMAU bar reaches about 65%, and the MMAR bar is around 25%. In the Qwen-2.5-Omni category, the MMAU bar is at approximately 65%, and the MMAR bar is close to 55%. The bars are grouped by category and do not appear to be sorted in any particular order, nor are any bars visually emphasized beyond their color coding. There is a legend on the top left of the chart to infer bars with their colors.
